decisions: The filed hypothesis STANDS -- sibling reconciliation rescues empty argument lists and leaves partial ones alone -- but the captain's refutation is right that the one-line gate flip is a measured regression, so the fix is a new discriminator rather than a relaxation.

The captain's diagnosis named onlyOpUse's CBRANCH rejection. Instrumented on the witness, the trial that actually decides is R8, not RCX: ancestor_op_use answers only=false at 0x10033c7 on a CPUI_STORE at 0x10036d5 (a competing use of the same register value a thousand bytes away, reached through a MULTIEQUAL), and fillin_map's positional rule then drops RCX behind the hole. RCX itself is only=false at the GOOD site too. The class is the same -- a competing use anywhere in the function sinks the last recovered trial -- but the specific opcode is STORE, not CBRANCH.

The discriminator is the callee's own body, and the load-bearing half is the NEGATIVE one: not 'the missing registers are read' but 'no OTHER argument register of the model is'. Liveness alone would have re-admitted the linker64 variadic regression, because an AArch64 va_start register-save area reads x3..x7 before writing them. Requiring the witness to be the callee's WHOLE register argument list refuses it.
No new probe was written: CalleeEntryDead already records read-before-write ranges for calleedeadarg's subtractive direction, so this adds one accessor (proves_read) and widens the seed gate.

Deferred-only, not in-order. On the witness the four short sites are the first four and the first five-argument site is the fifth, so an in-order rule has no witness at any of them; reordering finalization is refused for calleearityfwd's reason (check_call_double_use reads whether another spec is still input_active while scoring).
